corrected_claim: Nikkei 225 crossed 40,000 for the FIRST time in its history on 4 March 2024 (intraday and closing) — not merely 'a level not seen in 40 years' (the prior record was ~38,957 set on 29 Dec 1989).

corrected_claim: India's weight in the MSCI Emerging Markets index peaked near 20% in 2024 (record high), then was reduced in steps through 2025-26 — falling below 14% (Moneycontrol) and reported at ~12% (BW Businessworld) as AI-driven markets (Taiwan, Korea, China) gained share.

notes: Claim matches well-documented history; 'about 40%' = upper end of reported intraday swings (30-41% cited). Broker bankruptcies (Alpari UK etc.) confirmed. Transcript's date tag 2022-09-16 is the video date, not the event.
